findings.detail: The first application test failed at a 240-frame CSV: original bridge limit was 64000 UTF-16 units and 128 chunks. Raised both bridge and matching CLI bounds to 128000/256 while keeping UTF-8 pacing; full UI script then passed including 240-frame export and independent integration.

Updated the original oversize fixture from 65000 to 128001 units to test the new bound; added a 96000-character plus Unicode response roundtrip and cross-chunk pacing check. Final full suite: 111 passed.

Twelve fixed-step release cases cover 200/600 budgets, 0/16/64-second preparation, 32-second free evolution and two release steps. Preparation step is held fixed. No spatial convergence, automatic equilibrium or long-time stability conclusion.

Mean kinetic uses trapezoidal time weighting over retained samples. All-history statistics do not follow the selected playback frame; includesInitial is false when initial frame is evicted. Missing metrics remain absent, and no stable verdict is returned.
